transcript: Your video is only half the job on YouTube. The title, description, chapters and thumbnail decide whether anyone finds it, and whether they stay.
Before uploading, export an MP4 and watch it all the way through. Catch typos and internal information, and jot down when each new section starts.
A good title says what viewers will learn, in the words they'd type. So Q4 Webinar becomes How to Plan a Q4 Marketing Budget for a Small Business.
Make the first two lines a plain summary, since they show before the more link. Then add three to five bullets, your chapters and your links.
List timestamps starting at zero, one per line with a title. Your section divider slides and point-making headlines become ready-made chapter titles.
Your slide headlines and speaker notes give you the chapters and description. On Pro, AI directs your deck into a video that holds viewers. Try Basic first at powerpoint2vid.com.
